title: Puzzle 3d Marquee Preview Perf
description: Add live highlight preview while dragging rectangle/lasso marquee and eliminate post-release freeze by caching projected footprints once per gesture and deferring host shell rebuild.
summary: Added live marquee selection preview: capture projected object/vortex/attraction footprints once per gesture, resolve hits on each pointermove via resolveMarqueeSelectionGesture against a frozen base selection (local store only, no host notify), restore on cancel. Commit reuses cached candidates and non-precise Box3 projection. noteSelection defers shell rebuild like select-all. Extended vitest for resolveMarqueeSelectionGesture and async deferred shell on noteSelection.
